name: SoFi Bank
notes: Researched from public sofi.com / support.sofi.com pages only (no sign-in). The mock bill is a SoFi Personal Loan. Payments: one-time online payment in the SoFi account, autopay, check/bill pay by mail, wire. Autopay: loan card > Set up next to Autopay off; cancel via Manage Autopay > Cancel autopay by the calendar day before it runs; turning autopay off removes the 0.25% rate discount and re-amortizes; Posting: autopay 8:00 AM PT, one-time 6:00 PM PT; one-time ACH can be cancelled until 6:00 PM PT. Due-date change for eligible fixed-rate loans once per 12 months to day 1-25 (Loan Details > Edit). Statements are electronic by default (paper by contacting support), so paperless is effectively always on. Sign-in with email + password; 2FA by text/voice code or authenticator app, email only as backup (mfa sms). Phone 855-456-7634. No guest pay (inferred). Reviewed 2026-10-09: removed autopay-eligibility and bi-weekly claims not stated on the cited SoFi article.

help.title: Paying your SoFi Personal Loan
paragraphs: Make a one-time payment through your SoFi account, set up autopay, mail a check or bill-pay check, or send a wire. Payments go first to any outstanding fees, then accrued interest, then principal.

One-time online payments post at 6:00 PM PT and autopay at 8:00 AM PT. Mailed checks take 7-10 business days, overnight checks generally 1 business day, and wires post the day they arrive. A due date on a weekend or holiday moves to the next business day without making you late.

help.title: Set up, update or cancel autopay
paragraphs: On your member dashboard click your loan card, then Set up next to Autopay off. Choose the monthly amount and a bank account. You can add an extra amount each month.

To cancel, log in, open the loan, click Manage Autopay and then Cancel autopay. You must cancel by the calendar day before the payment is scheduled, or it will process. Turning autopay off removes the 0.25% interest rate discount and re-amortizes the loan.
steps: Log in and click your loan card.
Click Set up next to Autopay off.
Choose the amount and bank account.

help.title: Changing your monthly due date
paragraphs: Eligible fixed-rate personal loans can change the due date after funding and the first processed payment, if the loan is in good standing, generally once every 12 months. Pick any day from the 1st to the 25th.

Open the loan, click Loan Details and then Edit next to the due date in the Payment section. The change can cause two payments in one month or small changes to the amount due. If you see a message that you cannot change it, chat in or call 855-456-7634.

help.title: Cancelling a payment
paragraphs: A scheduled one-time ACH payment can be cancelled until 6:00 PM PT on the day it is set to process.

help.title: Loan statements
paragraphs: Statements are electronic and available in your SoFi account by default; fixed-rate loan statements are usually ready around the 15th of each month. To get paper statements, contact SoFi Support.

help.title: Two-factor authentication
paragraphs: Besides your email and password, SoFi may ask you to confirm it is you with a one-time code by text or phone call, or a code from an authenticator app, for example on a new device, after 30 days of inactivity, or when you reset your password.
Email can be added only as a backup method, not as the primary one.
